review: Independent documentation-only D3 time/DCS mapping review
scope: One two-path new doc correctness/boundary/plan pass. Prior462d/696/e582 time, acd/033 sound and earlier three-primary-declaration reviews reused. No implementation, active-worktree edit, build/test/native rerun, live DCS check or external write.

findings.title: Keep tested time coverage separate from the supported input domain
findings.evidence: The proposed time table says the adapter never feeds a value outside what the closed cases covered without a new reviewed case. Those cases sampled100/250/50ms; they do not establish an exclusive accepted domain. The existing public API accepts u32 milliseconds and the new prose otherwise correctly describes elapsed model-time conversion with fractional carry. Turning coverage into an input prohibition can introduce undocumented quantization/stall/scheduling changes.
findings.required_correction: State the sampled evidence limit without changing the API domain. Define any future DCS adapter cadence, conversion range, overflow/stall and refusal policy separately as an explicit design decision with appropriate validation; do not derive a new campaign restriction solely from these three tested values.

findings.title: Remove unsupported wind determinism and validation claims
findings.evidence: The pinned declaration calls getWind steady/excluding turbulence; it does not prove time invariance, no internal randomness, deterministic sampling or campaign replay reproducibility. Current ss_hostenv wind validation only requires finite speed and, when requested, three finite vector components. The Lua/Rust bridge also validates shape/exact numeric representation, not a scalar/vector norm relationship; its existing test explicitly accepts speed3 with vector{1,0,-2}. The document incorrectly labels mutual consistency as a current Core source-enforced property.
findings.required_correction: Qualify steady-wind selection as a proposal, not reproducibility proof. Describe the current finiteness/shape checks exactly. Define scalar/vector coherence, sample altitude/point, turbulence and temporal sampling as the DCS provider mapping responsibilities/open design choices; do not add new Core validation or change accepted reference words merely to match this document.

bounded_clear_facts: The old weather ownership reversal is corrected: host independently owns/evolves the reference field and Core holds its compatibility mirror. Source time ownership/manual writer/seed epoch/phase statements are substantially supported, with the stated unlocked substeps and cache/history limits. Say updates derive from the previous outer delta rather than implying every entity sees the unsplit delta.

The new generated env.export.ts blob/SHA matches its receipt and document, including version marker2.9.29.27468. It supplies a data shape only. Earlier three declarations remain reused at their verified hashes; no numeric weather enum/runtime/readability behavior is established.

The authored paired static weather concept is explicitly different from observed DCS precipitation. Equality comparisons avoid decoding unknown numeric flags, random local weather/different fixed mode/import mismatches are proposed refusals, and dynamic detection and authored-versus-DCS divergence are disclosed. This is a viable bounded workaround concept, not an implemented or completed provider contract.

Reference init_fixed sets the global local_weather_model flag false, mode/target equal and transition status0. Automatic weather strikes are in the local branch. The reference step still evolves wind outside that branch: a custom DCS step/frozen carrier policy must not be confused with unchanged init_fixed/reference evolution.

The sound section preserves actual78 versus documentation4d identities and retains loader/Core-policy limits. Its pending status is a historical author checkpoint and must be updated from the separate033 actual report when delivery status is refreshed, without relabelling native78.
remaining_M5_design_information: Fix the selected-point policy for the existing WIND{x,z} request: no altitude is transmitted. Choose a supported sampling altitude/profile restriction or an explicitly reviewed contract change; do not describe a caller altitude as available today. State scalar speed versus vertical/horizontal vector treatment and when values are sampled/cached. DCS native confirmation is an M6 check, but the design choice itself remains M5 work.

Specify the complete static-provider import/initialization/export/step carrier profile and rejection boundary, including how accepted session defaults become the authored state before derived answers and what happens to wind/gust/ambient/lightning fields. init_fixed alone does not freeze wind; current import is an acknowledgement, not a returned replacement-state payload. This can be a concise design contract, not a new framework or implemented schema.

Relate authored thresholds, wind/gust and ambient answers to the same selected DCS wind observation, or explicitly declare which compatibility data drives each. Keep source-bound exact equality/type/key validation and unsupported static/dynamic conditions distinct from a guarantee that DCS precipitation matches the authored mode.

A captured mission, numeric enum interpretation and live env.mission behavior are not fabricated. If the chosen workaround intentionally needs no decoding, retain its explicit scope and runtime validation checks; the placeholder file is not captured evidence and does not close the remaining mapping choices.
consumer_scope_qualification: Treat named wind/weather users as source readers with route qualifications, not proof each runs in the supported public headless frame. The inspected wn_move wind read is in the host weapon-step lookup bridge and is not dismissed as classic-only. Smoke/speech/render/cockpit/EO readers require their own existing caller dispositions; this doc adds no global liveness or dormancy result and should label inventory versus reached/required. No new whole-corpus inventory is requested.
limits: Two material documentation findings remain; no source/runtime regression is inferred. M5 call/workaround planning is not implementation or native DCS execution.

No new time-domain/product, live audio/UI product, global weather consistency, full physical-time service, Task51/D3/49/50, shipping40/all8/Tacview, final CI or normal-delivery acceptance. Running shipping78 pack is outside this review.
